sloka: विदितं भवतामेतद्यथा मे राज्यमुत्तमम् ।पूर्वकैर्मम राजेन्द्रैस्सुतवत् परिपालितम् ॥२-२-४॥
transliteration: viditaṁ bhavatāmetadyathā me rājyamuttamam ।pūrvakairmama rājendraissutavat paripālitam ॥2-2-4॥

translations.english: It is wellknown to all of you that people of this greatest kingdom were ruled by my predecessors who were great kings, who looked after the subjects as though they were their own children.
translations.hindi: श्वेत बादल के समान सफेद रङ्ग के, श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के भवन . में वसिष्ठ जी पहुँचे ओर तीन ड्योढ़ियों तक रथ ही में बैठे हुए चले गए
